name: Delivery Format Presets
purpose: Single source for delivery formats: landscape 16:9, portrait 9:16 and square 1:1 sizes (720p/1080p/4K where defined), default size, safe-area insets per format, allowed frame rates and the text-size floor.
capabilities: Drives scripts/studio.py formats/validate, the studio runtime layout variables and frame-review safe-area checks

compatibility.notes: Safe areas are conservative platform-agnostic insets, not any single platform's official overlay map.

approval_evidence: Used by the three-format chai project and the runtime self-test (2026-10-30).
